illusione--original-documents.description: Original Documents is Illusione's core Nicaraguan puro, its sizes marked with cryptic names such as 88, 888, MJ12 and CG:4. The blend draws on Nicaraguan Criollo '98 and Corojo '99 under a Corojo Rosado wrapper, and the collection took on a shared band design in 2023. Sweet leather, cocoa and nuts run through the smoke, with oak and black pepper behind.

thirds.notes: Cocoa and a soft, marshmallow-like creaminess, touched with leather and earth; spice waits in the background.
The creamy character grows and becomes the main thread.
Spice moves to the foreground for the finish.

sources.title: Cigar Dojo – Original Documents Habano Churchill (line redesign)

illusione--candela.description: Candela is the green-wrapped member of Illusione's Original Documents family: a Nicaraguan candela leaf over Nicaraguan binder and filler, rolled at TABSA in Nicaragua. Pepper and cream lead from the start, and as it burns, nuts, a light brown-sugar sweetness and cocoa come forward, with a touch of coffee near the end.

thirds.notes: Pepper builds quickly over cream, nuts and a little cocoa.
The pepper eases and creaminess takes over, with a light sugary sweetness and peanut-like nuttiness.
Flavors grow bolder, adding cocoa, spice and a touch of coffee toward the end.

illusione--epernay.description: The Epernay blend first appeared in 2008 as a limited release for the European Cigar Cult Journal before becoming a regular Illusione line, conceived as a lighter companion to Champagne. A Rosado wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and Corojo-Criollo filler. Dry wood and gentle spice open into cream and honeyed sweetness, closing on cedar; a refined choice for daytime.

thirds.notes: Dry, dusty wood and soft baking spice with a light, creamy finish and floral hints.
The wood recedes as a sweeter, creamy core takes over, with a hint of honey.
Cedar and oak come forward with a nutty edge and a lingering honeyed sweetness.
